verdict.reason: Bytes intact and decodable; the record, frame choice and provenance all persisted. Before the move the layer canvas was 'unsized' — for 'unsized' this is the single branch in WarpedRasterLayer.redraw() where computeBackingRect returns null because the padded viewport does not intersect the drape, which sets canvas width/height to 0. Zoom to point moved the viewport onto the drape and it repainted. NOT a render defect and NOT lost bytes: the viewport is simply not restored across reload.
